bio: Computer Science Engineer and Neural Architect focused on the intersection of Artificial Intelligence and high-performance systems. I specialize in crafting autonomous agents and immersive digital experiences that bridge the gap between complex backend logic and seamless human interaction. Driven by a passion for continuous learning and consistent open-source contribution, I aim to build impactful solutions that define the future of technology.
